content:
Dear Lean community,

I am founding the Berkeley Research Academy to speed up the rollout of Lean/AI capabilities to mathematicians worldwide.

We are currently testing the new research system with 1 professional research manager, 10 research projects across math / Lean / AI, and around 40 researchers from around the world. We will to pitch to venture capital funds soon.

My co-founder Armand Khchirian would like to speak with you as soon as possible to better represent the interest of the Lean community. A short discussion of 15 minutes should suffice. Please reach out to Armand directly at armand-dominick@berkeley.edu.

Please note: This is an exceptional research initiative and not an official UC Berkeley program.

Best wishes,
Jasper van de Kreeke
What is the value proposition to the VCs?

Simply speaking, we sell research managers to scientists, cutting their supervision effort by up to 75%, and enabling them to run large projects, including math/Lean/AI projects. The master-apprentice system is dying.
